column3: “Prince of the head” is rendered “prince of Rosh.”
“Lead on you” is a rare verb; NASB has “drive you on.”
“Birds of prey of every wing” is rendered “every kind of predatory bird.”
“Kindle and kindle” is rendered “make fires … and burn,” and “body shield” as “bucklers.”
“Valley of the Travellers” is rendered “valley of those who pass by.”
“For a name” is rendered “to their renown.”
“People of continuity” is rendered “men who will constantly pass through.”
“Birds of every wing” is rendered “every kind of bird.”
“Princes of the land” is rendered “princes of the earth,” and NASB supplies “as though they were.”
“To satiety” is rendered “until you are glutted.”
“Turn back the captivity” is rendered “restore the fortunes.”
“They will bear their disgrace” is rendered “they shall forget,” following a slightly different reading.
“I have poured out” is rendered “I shall have poured out,” and “spirit” as “Spirit.”
